name: budget-guard
description: A quiet usage line above the prompt that appears only when cost, context or your plan window needs a look, and an optional spending limit that asks before the next prompt instead of refusing. Type usage for a short report.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Track usage, show the line and apply the spending limit. Off: the mod does nothing at all.

limitUsd.title: Spending limit (USD per session)
limitUsd.description: 0 = no limit. When the session estimate reaches it, the next prompt you type asks once: continue (+50%), continue without a limit, or hold it. Tool calls in a running turn are never stopped. Typing budget 10 sets it for the current session only.

contextWarnPct.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarnPct.description: Show the usage line when the context window is at least this full.

showLine.title: Usage line
showLine.description: Show the quiet usage line above the prompt box (terminal and desktop). It stays hidden until something matters.
